facts.fact: The OGP Independent Reporting Mechanism says Nigeria launched its Beneficial Ownership Register in 2023, accessible to government institutions, CSOs, journalists and citizens, and used by regulatory and enforcement agencies.
The Registrar-General said CAC operates as a fully digital, end-to-end registry accessible 24 hours a day, receiving close to 10,000 business registration requests daily.

The Corporate Affairs Commission unveiled a pilot AI-enabled online registration platform on which a company is registered with a director's NIN, with a certificate emailed in a target of under 30 minutes.
The Corporate Affairs Commission says companies register on its Company Registration Portal, at no cost for the tax number.

The Corporate Affairs Commission says the FIRS tax identification number is generated automatically upon incorporation and endorsed on the certificate, the two agencies having fully integrated the service.
